_: Phase 8: how the Modbus links behave and what shows a link fault. 'tested' = from a document, held by tests/lanes/qa/phase8-link.cjs; 'nosource' = no document read gives it (the docs searched are named). tests/lanes/qa/phase8-gate.cjs reads this file.

tested.what: fly ash watch dog: the DCS sends 40052.15 (Watch Dog Sending Signal) and the PLC returns it on 40009.15 (Watch Dog Receiving Signal); the bit changes every DCS cycle
tested.src: LMYP-1 #1-MODBUS Communication list between DCS and fly ash.xls (src/ui/plant/modbus.js); src/analog/engine/pkg.js P.wd

tested.what: ESP watch dog WTD FOR COMMUNICATION CHECK: DCS 40026.10 out, PLC 30018.15 back, changes every DCS cycle
tested.src: LMYP-1 #1-MODBUS Communication list between DCS and ESP.xls

tested.what: CTCS COMMUNICATION ACTIVE BIT: DCS coil 18 out, PLC 15 back, changes every DCS cycle
tested.src: LMYP-1 #1-MODBUS Communication list between DCS and CTCS.xls

tested.what: TR01 ~ TR05 COMMUNICATION ERROR STATUS (ESP 30019.00 ~ .04): 0 in service
tested.src: ESP Modbus list; the TR controllers talk to the ESP PLC (ED p110)

tested.what: alive bit: the DCS sends Modbus 25 (DO25, STN102 WM r2602) on line A and line B and changes it every DCS cycle; the TCS sends it straight back on DO_0068 of each line = Modbus 10068 (TCT081D BTR 008 / 015)
tested.src: Turbine Modbus list r28 / r71; STN102 WM r2549 / r2565 / r2602; TCS backup ETH+MD TCT081D; YUA PC read 2026-11-27 (/mnt/project-files/phase8-modbus-linkfail-2026-11-27.md); src/analog/engine/tcs.js tcsLinkStep

tested.what: TCS side: a line is dead when its alive bit stays at 1 or at 0 for 10.0 s (TP 031 / 034 line A, TP 035 / 038 line B); the TCS takes the DCS commands from the healthy line; both lines dead = the 15 DCS commands into the TCS are forced OFF (0); no trip, no TCS alarm. The instructor cuts a line with the field states fs.tcs.linkA / linkB (Plant menu)
tested.src: TCS backup ETH+MD sheet TCT090A (2016/10/04) with TCT090; YUA PC read 2026-11-27 (/mnt/project-files/phase8-modbus-linkfail-2026-11-27.md); src/analog/engine/tcs.js tcsLinkStep / tcsLinkRefuse

tested.what: a cut line brings nothing back: the DCS keeps the last echo value it got (the station holds the previous value on a transmission error)
tested.src: FCS2000 manual 06 OPERATION COMMON SPECIFICATION 1.3.6 p27 note 1; YUA PC read 2026-11-27 (/mnt/project-files/phase8-modbus-linkfail-2026-11-27.md)

tested.what: TCS side: MODBUS CPU(A) / (B) NORMAL = 1 and MODBUS P.S(A) / (B) ABNORMAL = 0 in service (TCA906-14 / 15 / 12 / 13 -> TCA052 -> TCA820 -> TCA822 Modbus I/F ABNORMAL -> COM MINOR TROUBLE)
tested.src: TCA052, TCA820, TCA822, TCA906 (TCA soft logic diagram, src/digital/tce)

tested.what: DCS side: the gateway cabinet system alarm GCS10F-SYSERR (STN104 I.057B) and GCS10DE-SYSERR (I.057A): 0 in service, 1 when the instructor sets the fault (Plant menu)
tested.src: K1AU3-E2-0-115 (gateway cabinets), alarm unit HALMA-12 SYSTEM ALM, TB2 1, 2; src/world/field/dcs.js

nosource.what: what the gateway GCS writes into the station memory when one Modbus slave stops answering (hold the last value or mark it bad), and the DCS screen blanking of PV / SV / MV
nosource.why: the FCS2000 display rule (manual 06 1.3.6 p27: tag in normal color, PV / SV / MV blanked, last value held inside) is for a transmission error between the screen and the station; manual 16 ch 33 (GCS Modbus setting, p33-7 ~ 33-9) does not say what the GCS writes for a lost slave. YUA PC read 2026-11-27 (/mnt/project-files/phase8-modbus-linkfail-2026-11-27.md)

nosource.what: the Modbus poll period of GCS10F for each package and for the TCS
nosource.why: the GCS Modbus poll is the setting "Time Interval" (ms) per connection in the MBS ModBus Setting screen (FCS2000 manual 16 ch 33.4 p33-8, example 10 ms); the LMYP value is only on the GCS itself, not in the doc set. GCS to station BC blocks: "Cycle 50", unit not written. Station scan 1.0 s. YUA PC read 2026-11-27 (/mnt/project-files/phase8-modbus-linkfail-2026-11-27.md)

nosource.what: the time a watch dog may stay still before the DCS calls the link failed, and the alarm text
nosource.why: the alarm bits exist: STN102 WB r393 / r394 LINE-A / LINE-B COMM. FAIL (DCS<->TURBINE), STN104 WB B.1270 ~ B.1274 (fly ash A / B, CTCS, ESP A / B), STN105 WB B.126E ~ B.127F (air dryers, compressors, WTS, SCADA, CHS); the comm lists mark the watch dogs STATUS CHANGE only, the 9 Modbus specs give no time-out, and the DITL sheets that set these bits are image-only PDFs not yet found. So the DCS fail time and any action are not in the docs; the app does not set these bits. YUA PC read 2026-11-27 (/mnt/project-files/phase8-modbus-linkfail-2026-11-27.md)
